provenance: Synthetic, manually labeled rubric diagnostics; not an independent benchmark.

severity.instructions: Rate the incident severity using the evidence.
criteria: important workflow blocked for some users
entire service unavailable to all users

cases.state: The footer has a spelling mistake. Every feature works normally.
The logo is slightly misaligned. No users are prevented from working.
A button has the wrong color, but it works correctly and all tasks can be completed.
The keyboard shortcut fails. Clicking the menu runs the same command successfully.
cases.evidence: An easy equivalent action remains available.

cases.state: The page needs one extra refresh to show new messages. Refreshing always fixes it.
cases.evidence: Minor extra step with an effective workaround.

cases.state: The date picker is broken, but typing the date manually works for everyone.
cases.evidence: Manual entry provides an easy workaround.

cases.state: A subset of customers cannot complete checkout. They have no workaround. Other customers can still buy.
cases.evidence: Important workflow blocked for some customers.

cases.state: Report export is completely broken for the finance team. Other teams and the rest of the service work.
cases.evidence: A team's important workflow is blocked.

cases.state: Users in one region cannot log in and have no alternative. Users elsewhere can log in normally.
cases.evidence: Some users are blocked; service is not down for everyone.

cases.state: The entire service is down. No user can access any feature.
All production servers are offline globally. Every customer is unable to use the application.
A complete worldwide outage has made the service unavailable to all users.
